data.exact_reserve_text:
Positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance are driven predominately by increased reinsurance recoveries due to the Cavello Bay 50% quota share.
Change in prior year provisions 14,053 (611,544) (597,491)
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 1,331.49m. The technical provisions note shows a gross increase in prior year provisions of GBP 14.053m (a small gross strengthening, ~1.06% of opening reserves). However net movements were materially favourable due to significant reinsurance recoveries (the Cavello Bay 50% quota share and other reinsurance effects/RITC take-on), which produced a large net release after reinsurance. Overall the gross reserve movement is a modest strengthening, while the net position benefitted from reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: Positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance are driven predominately by increased reinsurance recoveries due to the Cavello Bay 50% quota share.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding, 2018 comparative column). Prior year development gross figure is taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' line in the Technical Provisions note (gross column). Net movements are heavily influenced by reinsurance (large reinsurers' share and an RITC take-on), which distorts net vs gross movements; narrative references to net releases are present but gross movement is the authoritative figure used. Gross premium mix values were read from the underwriting analysis table; some small line items are negative and OCR/readability of small numbers introduces minor uncertainty.
